reason: A Windows DeepSeek Harness plugin that patches sandbox and related process spawns so PowerShell and bash console windows remain hidden during confined commands.

summaries.zh: 用于 Windows 版 DeepSeek Harness，在沙箱命令执行期间隐藏 PowerShell 和 bash 控制台窗口，避免黑色窗口闪烁。
summaries.en: A Windows DeepSeek Harness plugin that hides PowerShell and bash console windows during sandboxed command execution to prevent flashing black windows.

capabilities: Modifies specific DeepSeek Harness package files under node_modules
Changes Windows child-process window visibility and spawn behavior
Runs an idempotent patch check on host startup
